items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: not Ed Lang, Joe Panoodi, and put it around the back of his fiddle

ctx.x: They gave that dirty sound, you know, like Tom Brown gets out of his trombone. That's the way he played fiddle. I tell you, it was the funniest thing ever. And marvelous, wonderful, terrific. And he took his ball off like Ed Lang does, not Ed Lang, Joe Panoodi, and put it around the back of his fiddle and played with the chords, you know. There wasn't anything Snoozer couldn't do. He was the greatest. He was, talk about Mr. Jazz. Snoozer Quinn was Mr. Jazz. A lot of people call him the audacity, call him a…
Where did he come from? Do you remember anything about his life at all, early life? Did he ever say anything?
